summary.text: Kara Hope is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives serving her fourth term for District 74, which includes all of south Lansing and Delhi Township.
She was elected to the House in 2018 and is a licensed attorney.

paragraphs.text: Hope grew up in a working-class union family in Ionia and was the first in her family to graduate from college, earning a bachelor's degree from Michigan State University in 1997 and a juris doctorate cum laude from Cooley Law School.
She has been a licensed attorney since 2003 and started a solo family law practice in 2015.
In 2012 she was elected to the Ingham County Board of Commissioners, serving three terms including one as chairperson.
In the House she has served as assistant majority floor leader, chairperson of the Criminal Justice Committee and vice chairperson of the Ethics and Oversight Committee.
